name: EQ Resources Limited
blurb: EQ Resources Limited is an Australian mining company focused on the exploration and production of tungsten and other mineral resources, with a secondary interest in gold. Its flagship asset is the Mt Carbine tungsten project in Far North Queensland, comprising two mining leases covering roughly 366 hectares. Formerly known as Speciality Metals International Limited, the company rebranded in December 2020 and is headquartered in Mount Carbine, Queensland. With approximately 259 employees and a market capitalisation of around A$1.49 billion, it operates within the Other Industrial Metals & Mining industry under the Materials sector.
